Title: Historia cultus Sinensium, seu varia scripta de cultibus Sinarum, inter vicarios apostolicos Gallos aliosque missionarios, et patres Societatis Jesu controversis, oblata Innocentio XII. pontifici maximo
Creator: Several authors: Nicolas Charmot's notes, Charles Maigrot's Mandate, bishops' letters, and writings of the Jesuits in an appendix (the title page names no author)
Publisher: Coloniae (title page; no printer named)
Publication Date: 1700 (first title page: 'Coloniae, M. DCC.', read on the page image, leaf n6, where the OCR drops the imprint; the second title page gives the place, which the OCR reads 'O O L O N I M', and 'M. D C C.' at OCR lines 15962 and 15971)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1700); the archive.org record carries the Public Domain Mark
Language: lat
Source: archive.org item bub_gb_vW4zWSxsvhIC, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-15 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (1,098,184) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1700, out of US copyright by date. OCR quality: clean Latin with the long s read as f. Google's stamp lines stand among the first 88 OCR lines and at the end. Word count of the host text: 155,815. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: A collection of the writings laid before the Pope in the Chinese rites case. Printer to the reader at OCR lines 48-80; Nicolas Charmot's notes on the Jesuits' observations on the Mandate (29 July 1698): title at 126-157, preface from 171, five sections at 254, 5148, 5599, 6377 and 7104; a brief of Innocent XII to Maigrot at 7941; Charmot's Notationes at 8194-13133; further pieces at 13134 and 14632. Maigrot's Declaratio seu Mandatum provisionale: heading at 15623, text from 15643, dated at Chang-lo in Fujian on 26 March (the year is garbled in the OCR), signed at 15920. A second title page follows at about 15925-15971. A later piece signed by Maigrot 'in Metropoli Fokiensi' on 10 November 1693 ends at 18820. Bishops' letters at about 19234-19938; replies and memorials from 23424; Jesuit observations at 27431-32074; index from 32210; 'Finis' at 32504. The pieces between 15922 and 23424 were not mapped one by one.
